borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission reference: 2025/00272/FUL dated 13th June 2025 for the "Deconversion of the existing property from 2no. self-contained flats into a single family dwellinghouse; erection of a rear roof extension, involving an increase in the ridge height by 300mm, including installation of 3no. rooflights in the front roofslope, 1no. rooflight on top of the main flat roof, and a dormer door with a Juliette balcony to the rear elevation; erection of a rear extension at second floor level, on top of the existing back addition; erection of a side infill extension at first floor level; erection of a single storey extension, to the side of existing back addition; alterations to the front facade to include restoration works with traditional detailing; installation of new enlarged windows to replace existing, to the front bay elevation at first and ground floor level; repositioning of an existing window, to the rear side elevation at first floor level; installation of new sliding doors to replace an existing window, to the rear elevation at ground floor level; excavation of the front and part of the rear garden to form lightwells, in connection with the creation of a new basement." Amendments sought to raise party wall height by 700mm to allow for a flat roof single storey side extension.
